changes.comment: Convert nested ControlSetup lazily so recursive setups work. fields and elements are now getters that convert on first read; previously convertSetup walked the whole setup tree eagerly, so legacy's DelayedSetup thunk idiom for self-referential shapes (fields: { children: { elems: () => treeSetup } }) recursed until the stack overflowed. The engine already reads a child's setup only when that child is created, and Object.keys does not fire getters, so each level now resolves exactly one step further. Converted setups are cached by their source object.
